scope: IHV cloud stage colors and lightning timing; asset probes use retail Q3 QVMs and do not establish IHV gameplay or full visual parity
working_tree: Uncommitted sky changes on top of prior IHV material/fog corrections

observations.stage_order: Stage zero stays white. Later stages update lightning before their active flag is checked, including the inactive terminator. At most eight stages.
observations.time: The integer frame time multiplies the original float .001 constant. The second threshold uses the rounded float elapsed value.
observations.colors: Cloud draw uses the sky iterator RGB and opaque alpha, ignoring generic color generators.

reference_probe.result: Every numeric result, random seed and per-shader flash timestamp matches; reproduced fixture parses identically
reference_probe.limitation: Original entry point, imports and rendering are not executed. GL state, draw and color calls are stubbed. No executable bytes are redistributed.
reference_probe.wrong_hash_rejection: Passed: unexpected source-file hash rejected before executing any reference function; .tmp/q3-ihv/reference-sky-rejection.log

implementation.profile: Q3 only, selected by IHV material syntax
implementation.state: One renderer-lifetime random stream, one last-flash timestamp per sky shader; per-batch colors clear after sky rendering and at surface startup
implementation.stage_preservation: IHV skies bypass vertex-light, white/filter and multitexture collapse; Vulkan uses vertex RGBA and preserves color computation between otherwise identical stages

validation.unit: Actual sky iterator and cloud-builder lifecycle, color dispatch, Vulkan pipeline and reuse branches. All 730 reference frames per renderer; max stages/vertices, output canaries, skipped and empty skies, shader-owned timestamps, seven-profile isolation. Clang x86 and x64 diagnostic builds pass with -ffast-math. Existing material and RTCW lighting controllers also pass.
validation.runtime: Twelve map-load/screenshot/clean-exit probes plus three 14-capture tim_dm1 sequences pass; 54 engine PNG captures total
validation.visual_inspection: tim_dm1 checkerboard sky replaced with clouds in all three renderers. GLx sequence frames 340 and 360 visibly differ with lightning. Other sequence views are obscured by fog or have little visible sky, so they are not independent visual lightning proof. Portal behavior and original lighting remain open.
validation.warnings: Every map has only the host IPv6 bind warning and the missing retail light-grid warning; no unknown IHV keyword warnings.
